theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 34 群

items.pos: adj. 安慰的；令人欣慰的
items.colloc: comforting words 安慰的話語 | comforting presence 令人安心的存在
items.distinct: comfortable 舒適的 | comforted 感到安慰的
ex: The manager offered some comforting words after the loss.
經理在虧損後說了一些安慰的話。
It is comforting to know that the project is secure.
知道專案很安全真是令人欣慰。
Her feedback provided a comforting sense of direction.
她的回饋帶來了一種令人安心的方向感。

items.pos: adj. 競爭激烈的；有競爭力的
items.zh: 競爭激烈的；有競爭力的
items.colloc: competitive market 競爭市場 | competitive price 具競爭力的價格
items.distinct: competent 有能力的 | completion 完成
ex: Our company offers very competitive salary packages.
我們公司提供非常有競爭力的薪資方案。
The retail industry is becoming increasingly competitive.
零售業正變得競爭越來越激烈。
We need a strategy to stay competitive globally.
我們需要一個策略來在全球保持競爭力。

items.pos: v. 推斷；達成；結束
items.colloc: conclude a deal 達成協議 | conclude the meeting 結束會議
items.distinct: decide 決定 | exclude 排除
ex: The committee will conclude the negotiations by Friday.
委員會將在週五前達成談判協議。
Analysts conclude that the market will rebound soon.
分析師推斷市場很快就會反彈。
We should conclude the presentation before the lunch break.
我們應該在午休前結束簡報。

items.pos: v. 連接；建立聯繫
items.colloc: connect with clients 與客戶建立聯繫 | connect to the network 連接到網路
items.distinct: contact 接觸；聯繫 | attach 附上
ex: Please connect your laptop to the projector.
請將你的筆電連接到投影機。
Networking helps you connect with potential business partners.
人脈經營有助於你與潛在商業夥伴建立聯繫。
The new highway connects the two major cities.
這條新高速公路連接了兩座大城市。

items.pos: n. 比賽；競賽 | v. 爭辯；質疑
items.colloc: sales contest 銷售競賽 | contest the results 質疑結果
items.distinct: content 內容 | context 上下文
ex: The annual design contest encourages creative marketing ideas.
年度設計競賽鼓勵創意的行銷點子。
We decided not to contest the recent audit findings.
我們決定不質疑最近的審計結果。
Several firms will contest for the government contract.
幾家公司將競逐這份政府合約。

items.pos: adj. 彎曲的；弧形的
items.colloc: curved surface 彎曲表面 | curved line 曲線
items.distinct: curved 彎曲的 | circle 圓形
ex: The office design features several elegant curved walls.
辦公室設計採用了幾個優雅的弧形牆面。
The screen has a slightly curved edge for comfort.
螢幕邊緣有輕微的弧度以增加舒適感。
He drew a curved line to represent the sales growth.
他畫了一條曲線來表示銷售成長。

items.pos: n. 日期；約會 | v. 註明日期
items.colloc: due date 到期日 | set a date 設定日期
items.distinct: data 資料 | deadline 最後期限
ex: Please confirm the delivery date for the order.
請確認這筆訂單的到貨日期。
The document was dated back to last January.
該文件註明的日期是去年一月。
We need to set a date for the board meeting.
我們需要為董事會設定一個日期。

items.pos: n. 辯論；討論 | v. 辯論；深思
items.colloc: public debate 公共辯論 | ongoing debate 持續的討論
items.distinct: discussion 討論 | argument 爭論
ex: There is a lot of debate regarding the new policy.
關於這項新政策有很多討論。
The team will debate the merits of the proposal.
團隊將辯論這項提案的優點。
They spent hours in debate over the budget allocation.
他們花了數小時討論預算分配問題。

items.pos: n. 沙漠 | v. 拋棄；擅離
items.colloc: desert island 荒島 | desert area 沙漠地區
items.distinct: dessert 甜點 | deserted 被遺棄的
ex: The company expanded its operations into the desert region.
該公司將業務擴展到沙漠地區。
We cannot desert our core values during the crisis.
我們在危機期間不能拋棄核心價值。
The project site felt like a desert after hours.
下班後，專案現場感覺像是一座沙漠。

items.pos: n. 灰塵；污垢
items.colloc: remove dirt 清除污垢 | dirt cheap 極度便宜
items.distinct: dust 灰塵（細小） | mud 泥土
ex: You should remove the dirt from the equipment regularly.
你應該定期清除設備上的污垢。
The warehouse floor was covered in layers of dirt.
倉庫地板上覆蓋著層層污垢。
Cleaning the windows helps keep the dirt away.
清潔窗戶有助於保持遠離灰塵。

items.pos: n. 灰塵 | v. 撣去灰塵
items.colloc: dust cover 防塵罩 | collect dust 積灰
items.distinct: dirt 污垢 | dark 黑暗
ex: Please dust the office desks before the clients arrive.
請在客戶抵達前把辦公桌上的灰塵撣掉。
The old files were covered in thick layers of dust.
舊檔案上覆蓋著厚厚的灰塵。
We use air purifiers to filter out the dust.
我們使用空氣清淨機來過濾灰塵。

items.pos: adv. 優秀地；卓越地
items.colloc: perform excellently 表現優異 | managed excellently 管理得當
items.distinct: excellent 優異的 | exceptionally 例外地
ex: The new intern performed excellently during the project.
新進實習生在專案期間表現優異。
The team handled the crisis excellently last week.
團隊上週出色地處理了危機。
Our software functions excellently on various operating systems.
我們的軟體在不同作業系統上運作得很好。

items.pos: n. 出口 | v. 出去；退出
items.colloc: emergency exit 緊急出口 | exit strategy 退出策略
items.distinct: entry 入口 | exceed 超過
ex: Please locate the nearest fire exit in the building.
請找出大樓內最近的消防出口。
Investors are looking for a clear exit strategy.
投資者正在尋找明確的退出策略。
He decided to exit the market due to low returns.
由於回報率低，他決定退出該市場。

items.pos: n. 出口商品 | v. 出口
items.colloc: export market 出口市場 | export goods 出口貨物
items.distinct: import 進口 | transport 運輸
ex: The country plans to export more agricultural products.
該國計畫出口更多的農產品。
Our main export includes high-tech electronic components.
我們的主要出口商品包括高科技電子零組件。
They expanded their export business to Southeast Asia.
他們將出口業務擴展到了東南亞。

items.pos: n. 工廠
items.colloc: factory floor 生產線；廠房 | open a factory 開設工廠
items.distinct: industry 工業 | workshop 工作坊
ex: The factory produces over five thousand units daily.
該工廠每天生產超過五千個單位。
We visited the manufacturing factory last month.
我們上個月參觀了製造工廠。
Workers at the factory are complaining about the heat.
工廠的工人正在抱怨炎熱問題。

items.pos: v. 折疊；倒閉 | n. 折痕
items.colloc: fold the paper 折紙 | fold the business 結束營業
items.distinct: hold 拿住 | bold 大膽的
ex: Please fold the brochures and put them in envelopes.
請把摺頁摺好並放入信封中。
The company had to fold after the economic downturn.
經濟衰退後，該公司不得不倒閉。
You can fold the laptop screen for easier transport.
你可以把筆電螢幕折疊起來以便攜帶。

items.pos: n. 資料夾；文件夾
items.colloc: file folder 文件夾 | digital folder 數位資料夾
items.distinct: holder 持有人 | binder 活頁夾
ex: All the project reports are in the blue folder.
所有的專案報告都在藍色資料夾裡。
I created a new folder to organize my emails.
我建立了一個新資料夾來整理郵件。
Please hand over the folder containing the contract.
請把裝有合約的資料夾交給我。

items.pos: adj. 前任的；以前的
items.colloc: former employee 前員工 | former position 原職位
items.distinct: formal 正式的 | later 後來的
ex: The former CEO will give a speech tomorrow.
前任執行長明天將會發表演說。
He returned to his former position at the bank.
他回到了銀行以前的職位。
We are meeting with a former business partner.
我們正要與一位前商業夥伴見面。

items.pos: adj. 新鮮的；嶄新的
items.colloc: fresh produce 新鮮農產品 | fresh idea 新穎的想法
items.distinct: flesh 肉體 | flash 閃光
ex: The cafe uses fresh ingredients for every dish.
那家咖啡廳每道菜都使用新鮮食材。
We need some fresh ideas for the marketing campaign.
我們需要一些新穎的想法來進行行銷活動。
The intern brings a fresh perspective to the team.
實習生為團隊帶來了嶄新的觀點。

items.pos: adj. 普遍的；一般的 | n. 將軍
items.colloc: general manager 總經理 | in general 總體而言
items.distinct: gentle 溫和的 | genuine 真誠的
ex: The general manager is responsible for daily operations.
總經理負責日常營運。
In general, the feedback from users has been positive.
總體而言，使用者的回饋是正面的。
We have a general idea of the project scope.
我們對專案範圍有一個大致的概念。
